tasks.instruction_text: I'm researching Senate hearings. Set the Duration filter on the C-SPAN video archive to the '1-2 hours' bucket so I see the standard committee-length hearings, not the short clips or the marathon mult
Switch the archive's Duration dropdown to the longest bucket — the 'Over 2 hours' tier for full-length floor debates and marathon confirmation hearings.
Help me find quick clips for a TV news package. Pick the shortest Duration bucket — 'Under 15 min' — not the next-tier 15-60 min one.
Filter the C-SPAN video archive to the '15-60 min' Duration bucket — typical markup and briefing length.
Apply the 'Over 2 hours' Duration bucket. Then tell me how many videos remain in that filtered view.
Set the Duration dropdown to the '1-2 hours' bucket, then within that filtered view tell me which video has the shortest duration and its exact length.
